transcript: Hello, and thank you for calling the information line for the lifeguard division for the city of Oceanside. Please choose from the following options for our weather and surf report. Water temperature is 73 degrees. There is a six mile per hour wind blowing out of the Northeast. Today's tide include a low of 2.3 at 01:19 this afternoon, falling to or rising to a high of 5.4 at 07:51PM. If you would like further information on the Oceanside Lifeguard services, please dial 435-4018. Thank you, and have a safe day. No one is available to take your call. Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
